inkCompatibility.description: An open-system ink platform with up to 12 dedicated colour channels, delivering expanded gamut coverage and smooth gradients while giving manufacturers complete freedom to select inks by fabric type, cost target, or supplier preference.

inkTypes.name: Open-System Ink Support
inkTypes.fabrics: Compatible with all ink types, giving manufacturers complete flexibility to select inks based on fabric type, cost target, or supplier preference without machine-imposed restrictions

inkTypes.name: 12-Color Extended Gamut
inkTypes.fabrics: Dedicated colour channels deliver expanded gamut coverage and smooth gradients for complex, photorealistic, and fine-detail designs

inkTypes.name: Color Spectrum
inkTypes.fabrics: Up to 12 installed colors configurable in Double CMYK, Double 8 Colors, or full 12-colour-per-row setups depending on production priority

features.description: Engineered around 12 dedicated colour channels, fully digital printhead alignment, and an open-system modular ecosystem that reconfigures between industrial speed and maximum colour quality.

items.title: Chromatic Perfection & Speed
items.desc: Offers high-definition results and industrial-speed production without compromising precision.

items.title: 12 Dedicated Color Channels
items.desc: Twelve dedicated colour channels deliver an expanded gamut and smooth, unbeatable gradients, bringing complex, high-detail designs to life with chromatic accuracy that standard 8-colour systems cannot match.

items.title: Open-System RIP Compatibility
items.desc: Built-in advanced queue manager integrates seamlessly with any RIP software on the market, giving production teams complete freedom to use their preferred existing workflow tools without forced software lock-in.

items.title: Fully Digital Printhead Alignment System
items.desc: Digital alignment eliminates manual mechanical adjustment, achieving maximum registration precision across all installed printheads and significantly reducing setup time between job changes.

items.title: Modular Speed Configuration
items.desc: Double CMYK or Double 8 Colors setup supporting up to 24 printheads delivers industrial-speed output optimised for fashion, fast fashion, and accessories production where throughput is the priority.

items.title: Modular Quality Configuration
items.desc: 12 colors per row configuration maximises colour gamut and gradient smoothness, tailored for swimwear, sportswear, premium accessories, and high-quality fashion brands where colour accuracy outweighs raw speed.

items.title: Open-System Ink Philosophy
items.desc: Support for all ink types across the modular ecosystem allows manufacturers to switch between reactive, acid, disperse, and pigment formulations as production needs change without hardware limitations.

items.title: Precision Pneumatic Control System
items.desc: 6 bar utility system with tightly controlled consumption range (20 to 300 L/min) ensures stable, consistent mechanical operation across all printhead and carriage functions.

items.title: Dual Water System Architecture
items.desc: Separate standard and demineralized water circuits, the latter consuming as little as 0.1 L/hr, support precise washing unit operation while minimising overall water resource demand.

idealFor.description: Built for manufacturers who need to flex between industrial throughput and colour-critical quality, the Twelve serves fashion, accessories, swimwear, sportswear, premium brands, and multi-brand job work from a single modular platform.

fabrics.title: Fashion and Fast Fashion Production
fabrics.desc: Speed Configuration with up to 24 printheads in Double CMYK or Double 8 Colors setup delivers the industrial throughput required for fashion brands and fast fashion manufacturers operating on tight turnaround cycles.

fabrics.title: Accessories Manufacturing
fabrics.desc: High-speed modular configuration suits accessory producers needing fast colour changeovers and high-volume output across scarves, bags, and fashion accessory fabric printing.

fabrics.title: Swimwear and Sportswear Production
fabrics.desc: Quality Configuration with 12 colors per row delivers the extended gamut and gradient smoothness required for vibrant, photorealistic swimwear and sportswear designs that demand maximum colour fidelity.

fabrics.title: Premium Accessories and High-Quality Fashion Brands
fabrics.desc: 12-colour gamut and digital alignment precision suit premium fashion houses and accessory brands where colour accuracy and fine design detail are non-negotiable production requirements.

fabrics.title: Multi-Brand Job Work Operations
fabrics.desc: Open-system RIP compatibility and flexible ink support make the Twelve a practical choice for job work printers serving diverse brands with varying software workflows and ink preferences.

fabrics.title: Mixed Speed and Quality Production Environments
fabrics.desc: Modular ecosystem design allows manufacturers to reconfigure between Speed and Quality setups as order mix shifts between high-volume fashion and premium colour-critical work.

productionCapacity.description: Configuration choice should align with production priority. Choose Speed Configuration (Double CMYK or Double 8 Colors, up to 24 printheads) for high-volume fashion and accessories runs, and Quality Configuration (full 12-colour-per-row setup) for colour-critical swimwear, sportswear, and premium brand work where gamut and gradient quality outweigh raw throughput.

globalComponents.description: Built using premium global components engineered for high-definition multi-colour output, precise registration, open-system integration, and stable continuous production.
